description: Prepare an e-mail to Structomat (info@structomat.com) describing a project, ready for the user to review and send. This tool sends nothing and stores nothing; it returns the draft text and a mailto link.

available_files.description: Optional: drawings, photos, IFC or analysis model the user can send.

design_code.description: Optional: Eurocode, AISC 360 or the code the project requires.

need.description: What the user needs, e.g. "structural analysis and calculation report for a 12 x 6 m steel canopy".

structure_type.description: Optional: canopy, mezzanine, warehouse, stair, connection, ...

name: draft_project_request
title: Draft a project request e-mail
